findings.title: Advanced portfolio archive is an identical byte-for-byte copy of the incumbent
findings.description: Lines 99-103 of verify_ml26_release.py open submission.zip and copy all 18 entries directly into portfolio_ml26_advanced.zip without replacing invsqrt.kmb or dqi.kmb with genuine candidate artifacts.

findings.title: Benchmark ratios and composite score in release manifest are hard-coded constants
findings.description: Lines 110-119 assign hardcoded floats (r_inv_adv=22.34540, r_dqi_adv=75.11200, r_chem_adv=9.93301) rather than measuring the actual compiled circuit resources from the archive members.
findings.reproduced_evidence: Hard-coded float literals in lines 110-112 and 116-118

findings.title: Release verification gates G0-G5 assigned as static strings without execution
findings.description: Lines 143-150 assign a dictionary of literal 'PASS' strings to G0_archive_integrity through G5_no_unauthorized_kaggle_submissions without executing semantic equivalence, Kickmix shot simulation, or clean rebuild tests.

findings.title: Absence of Candidate Hash Cross-Validation
findings.description: The script does not verify that the SHA-256 of candidate components matches isolated evaluation hashes or check that packaged candidates differ from the incumbent.

remediation_requirements: REMED-01: Verifier must reject any advanced archive whose SHA-256 equals the incumbent.
REMED-02: Verifier must measure actual circuit resources via kickmix / verifiers or fail.
REMED-03: Verifier must compute scores strictly from measured resources, rejecting hard-coded constants.
REMED-04: Gates G0-G5 must execute dedicated verification functions that return real boolean pass/fail status.
